item.text: Slide 3 has two image objects; the actual photo is the JPEG picture named `Picture 7`, so I’m setting that object to 20 cm high while preserving its aspect ratio. Slide 6’s named text boxes with text will have their run font sizes changed to 40 pt.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, shutil, os, tempfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

path='/home/user/Desktop/42_2.pptx'
backup=path + '.bak-before-codex'
if not os.path.exists(backup):
    shutil.copy2(path, backup)

ET.register_namespace('a','http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main')
ET.register_namespace('r','http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships')
ET.register_namespace('p','http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main')
ns={'p':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main','a':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main','r':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'}
A=ns['a']; P=ns['p']
EMU_PER_CM=360000
TARGET_CY=20*EMU_PER_CM
TARGET_FONT='4000'

with zipfile.ZipFile(path, 'r') as zin:
    contents={name: zin.read(name) for name in zin.namelist()}

# Slide 3: set the actual JPEG photo (Picture 7 / rId2) to 20 cm high, preserving aspect ratio.
root=ET.fromstring(contents['ppt/slides/slide3.xml'])
changed_pic=False
for pic in root.findall('.//p:pic', ns):
    cNvPr=pic.find('.//p:cNvPr', ns)
    blip=pic.find('.//a:blip', ns)
    ext=pic.find('.//a:ext', ns)
    if cNvPr is None or blip is None or ext is None:
        continue
    name=cNvPr.get('name')
    rel=blip.get('{%s}embed' % ns['r'])
    if name == 'Picture 7' or rel == 'rId2':
        old_cx=int(ext.get('cx'))
        old_cy=int(ext.get('cy'))
        ext.set('cy', str(TARGET_CY))
        ext.set('cx', str(round(old_cx * TARGET_CY / old_cy)))
        changed_pic=True
if not changed_pic:
    raise SystemExit('Did not find target picture on slide 3')
contents['ppt/slides/slide3.xml']=ET.tostring(root, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)

# Slide 6: set all text in TextBox shapes to 40 pt.
root=ET.fromstring(contents['ppt/slides/slide6.xml'])
changed_text=0
for sp in root.findall('.//p:sp', ns):
    cNvPr=sp.find('./p:nvSpPr/p:cNvPr', ns)
    txBody=sp.find('./p:txBody', ns)
    if cNvPr is None or txBody is None:
        continue
    if not (cNvPr.get('name') or '').startswith('TextBox'):
        continue
    for rPr in txBody.findall('.//a:rPr', ns):
        rPr.set('sz', TARGET_FONT)
        changed_text += 1
    for defRPr in txBody.findall('.//a:defRPr', ns):
        defRPr.set('sz', TARGET_FONT)
if changed_text == 0:
    raise SystemExit('Did not update any textbox text on slide 6')
contents['ppt/slides/slide6.xml']=ET.tostring(root, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)

fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.pptx', dir=os.path.dirname(path))
os.close(fd)
try:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, 'w', compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for name, data in contents.items():
            zout.writestr(name, data)
    shutil.copystat(path, tmp)
    os.replace(tmp, path)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(tmp):
        os.remove(tmp)
print('updated', path)
print('backup', backup)
PY"
